summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 20, 2026 press release confirming cancellation of 26,951,230 common shares (equivalent to 1,078,049 ADSs), roughly 1.5% of total issued shares, under its ongoing buyback program announced September 23, 2026 targeting repurchase and cancellation of 3.9% of outstanding shares. No price per share, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed; signed by Group General Counsel Sebastian Rice. The US-equivalent structure is an issuer share repurchase with cancellation, reducing share count and overhang. Watch remaining program capacity, pace of ADS purchases and any Nasdaq ADS ratio effects.
